total_repository_tests.description: Full Repository Test Collection (including live network/model integration suites)

relationship: The 228-test suite is the canonical offline unit test suite established in Prompt 1 covering 17 core modules without external live-model dependencies. The 96-test suite is a focused surgical subset executed in Prompt 3 covering historical bug fixes, parser robustness, telemetry, workspace path security, tool security gates, planner, verifier, and week 5 final. Neither 228 nor 96 runs the entire 1015-test repository suite (which contains long-running end-to-end integration tests). Both the 228-test canonical suite and the 96-test focused suite pass with 100% pass rates.
evidence: Prompt 1 baseline report records 228 collected / 228 passed in 13.47s.
